messages: Asha R: Heads-up — docs preview failed for `migration/private-deploy-v2.md`. Linkcheck + vale both errored on the new migration section. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/12345 :frowning_face: Liam K: Ugh, I saw that. vale is flagging passive-voice in the 'rollback' paragraph, and markdownlint is unhappy about frontmatter ordering. Linkcheck shows one internal anchor 404 (the SDK snippet anchor). Jules: Can you paste the vale rule hits? I can try a quick rewrite. If it's small we can get this through the merge window today. docs-bot: docs-ci-preview #12345 status: failed — linkcheck(1), vale(2), md-lint(1) — rerun with `./ci docs-preview --pr 12345` Asha R: vale hits: "PRH001 passive voice" on lines ~82-95; md-lint: "front-matter-order" (aliases before slug); linkcheck: `#python-embed-example` not found (we renamed the header to "Python SDK embedding"). Priya S: I can do the header rename back to match the anchor, or add an explicit anchor. Which is faster for a hotfix? Liam K: Quickest is to add an explicit HTML anchor above the snippet: `` then re-run preview. If vale still complains we can rewrite the sentence to active voice. Jules: I'll open a tiny PR with the HTML anchor + frontmatter reorder and a one-line rewrite. Title: "docs: fix migration guide anchors and vale". Will tag @Priya S and @Asha R as reviewers. Asha R: Thanks. Can we get a merge slot before the 17:00 release window? There's a dependent changelog update waiting on this doc. Priya S: I have a merge slot at 16:30 — I can watch the CI and merge on green. If the run flakes, ping me with :eyes:. Jules: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/429 — small changes, CI kicked. cc @Asha R Liam K: Added a tiny vale-safe rewrite: "We recommend rolling back by performing X" -> "To roll back, perform X". That should clear PRH001. docs-bot: docs-ci-preview #12346 status: success — all checks passed (linkcheck, vale, md-lint). Preview: https://preview.docs.internal/redwood/migration/private-deploy-v2.html Asha R: Awesome — thanks everyone. Priya can you merge at 16:30 and I'll coordinate the changelog deploy? Priya S: Will do. Merging on green at 16:30 UTC. :thumbsup: Jules: Quick note for the future: avoid renaming header IDs in the same PR that changes anchors elsewhere. Small change, big CI churn. Asha R: Agreed. I'll add a short note to the docs CONTRIBUTING.md about anchor-preserving header edits. Priya S: Merged at 16:33 UTC. Release task unblocked. :tada: Asha R: Great job, team.
